verdict.rationale: SigNoz offers no documented native feature that generates AI summaries of incidents or alert context for responders. Its first-party MCP server and Agent Skills let external AI agents (Claude, Cursor, etc.) query data and 'investigate alerts.' Any summarization would come from the user's own external agent, which makes these building blocks adjacent to the story rather than delivery of it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries of incidents and alert context for responders
